newsitem.title: GERMANY: German FDP says still opposes tax increases.
newsitem.headline: German FDP says still opposes tax increases.

text.p: Germany's Free Democrat (FDP), junior coalition partners in Chancellor Helmut Kohl's centre-right government, reaffirmed their position on Friday that no tax increases should follow the 18 billion mark hole in 1997 tax receipts announced on Thursday.
"The situation in the jobs market pushes us towards any (budgetary) measure that does not involve tax increases," FDP chief Wolfgang Gerhardt said in a statement.
The FDP has proposed that the government introduce further spending cuts and accelerate its privatisation programme to cover budget shortfalls.
